description: PFSS reconstructs an approximate coronal magnetic field from observed photospheric magnetograms. The documented implementation uses a potential-field source-surface formulation as a solar-wind modelling input. The resource is documented by University of California, Berkeley. The documented physical domain is Solar; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request, Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The potential-field approximation excludes important non-potential coronal structure. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
